text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "friend" was no longer the only one 
Manhattan Cafe aimed to take on the world 
alongside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bonds forged through Project L'Arc are 
truly giving me the push I need right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the nighttime training track, she 
declared that she would defeat <chrname> in the 
next Inter-School Exhibition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A quiet declaration of war, like a night 
breeze—upon whom will the sun of victory 
shine?
